title: Normalized findable item definition (legacy findable_items domain)
description: Contract for one normalized findable item: one stored legacy findable_items entry. The stored integer id is the stable identity, so legacy_id is its decimal form (rule S2); native amounts and display strings are kept verbatim (rule S1). See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey citations.

legacy_id.description: Stored findable_items id preserved verbatim as a string (rule S2): the decimal form of the native integer id.

kind.description: Classification of the stored findable_items domain: every entry maps to findable_item.

source_file.description: Origin file of the stored entry: config/main.json (no patch targets findable_items).

source_layer.description: Layering origin: stored (no patch targets findable_items).

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over the stored source bytes plus the mods list); sources carry no version stamp.

id.description: Native stored findable id, kept verbatim (rule S1).

title.description: Findable display title, preserved verbatim (rule S1).

description.description: Findable display description, preserved verbatim (rule S1).

coins.description: Native stored coin reward, kept verbatim (rule S1).
